messages.subject: ggplot in a renderplot
parts:
Hi All,
 
I have a dataframe with 10 columns one of which is Time. I am trying to make a plot with x as Time and Y as a user input. the plot should change as the user changes the y variable( from the others columns in the dataframe).
I am giving the user a Drop down(  selectInput in Shiny, with a single input allowed).
 
selectInput("var","Select the variable",colnames(DF),multiple=F,selected= "any one out of the 9"),
 
In the server.R,
 
I am using this to plot the graph,
 
output$plot3=renderPlot({

ggplot(DF,aes(x= as.Date(Time),y =input$var))+ geom_line() + labs(x="Date",y=input$var)+scale_x_date(breaks = "1 day")+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) 
 
})
 
 
I get the following error,
 
object 'input' not found
 
I guess this is due to input$var being a character and not a formulae. But I don't know how to convert in into a formula. Using as.formulae did not work.
 
Please help.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: ggplot in a renderplot
parts:
Try replacing the aes(...) call with:

aes_string(x = "as.Date(Time)", y = input$var)
